title: lean but mean
description:
Forge modpack created out of an older modpack focused in getting the most out performance but with some adventure and world building mods.
Some dungeons but not that much that it overstuffs the world generation.
body:
Forge modpack created out of an older modpack focused in getting the most out performance but with some adventure and world building mods.
Some dungeons but not that much that it overstuffs the world generation.
Focused on:
- Performance
- Adventure
- Some Multiplayer features
- Create (all of create)
- No Magic
- Dungeons
- World Exploration
